d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ekdam majedaar spicy aur chatpati Tamata Pachadi ki Recipe share kar raha hu, ye ek type ka instant andhra style achar hua ya chutney hui jo ki vedi vedi annam, matlab garam garam rice ke saath khane me maja aa jata hai. Jab bhi aapko fatafat lunch karna ho to ye bana ke rakhiega, maja aa jaega!
Ingredients:
Imli - 2 nimbu size ball
Garam paani - imli bhijane ke liye
Mungfali ka tel - 4 karchi
Sarso - 2 tsp
Jeera - 1 tsp
Sukhi lal mirch - 6-7
